item.title: Monaco Energy Boat Challenge to return to the Principality for 13th edition
item.description: The Yacht Club de Monaco will once again host the Monaco Energy Boat Challenge from July 8th to 11th, bringing together 43 teams from 21 nationalities for four days of sustainable boat racing.

item.title: Football: Monaco bounce back from Champions League exit with Angers win
item.description: AS Monaco's elimination from the Champions League confirmed that, if they are to qualify for European football next season, they must do so through their league finish. Sébastien Pocognoli's men set about that task by registering a 2-0 win over Angers on Saturday.

item.title: Dalí’s largest ever painting — with a Monaco connection — heads to auction in Paris
item.description: A monumental work by Salvador Dalí, considered the largest painting the artist ever created, will lead Bonhams' annual Surrealism sale in Paris on 26th March — and its origins have an unexpected connection to Monaco.

item.title: Monaco issues urgent travel warning for Middle East as region erupts
item.description: Monaco has issued an urgent travel warning for the Middle East as the region faces its worst security crisis in years, following the killing of Iran's Supreme Leader in a US-Israeli strike.

item.title: Four chefs, a Broadway star and a surprise from the Palace — Forbes Travel Guide holds its annual gala in Monaco
item.description: Forbes Travel Guide held the gala dinner for its annual Summit conference at the Salle des Étoiles in the Monte-Carlo Sporting Club on Thursday evening, bringing together senior figures from the global luxury hospitality industry.

item.title: Middle East airspace closes and flights cancelled worldwide
item.description: Flights cancelled, airports closed and airspace shut across the Middle East — here is what travellers need to know as war with Iran brings global aviation chaos.

item.title: Monaco promotes free colorectal cancer screening during awareness month
item.description: Health officials say early detection remains the most effective defence against the disease, with survival rates reaching nearly nine out of 10 cases when cancer is identified at an early stage.

item.title: Melting ice, fraying alliances: Monaco’s Polar Symposium brings polar world together to find answers
item.description: From 25th to 27th February, more than 100 Arctic and Antarctic experts gathered in Monaco to confront a pressing challenge: how to turn fast-moving polar research into real-world policy and action.

item.title: Powher to spotlight sport and health for this year’s International Women’s Day
item.description: Visitors will be able to move through eight interactive workshops, each representing a life stage from childhood to old age, and also take part in a treasure hunt.

item.title: Inside Charles Leclerc’s private Monaco wedding as couple release first images
item.description: Formula 1 star Charles Leclerc has married partner Alexandra Saint Mleux in a private civil ceremony on the Rock, with the couple confirming the news themselves after a weekend of secrecy.
